title: empty_to_dash now returns a hyphen, not a dash: misleading name and worse PDF placeholder
detail: The function empty_to_dash now returns a hyphen, not a dash. On the audit cover page a lone '-' reads as a stray typo where the em-dash read as an intentional no-data marker.
recommended_fix: Revert the placeholder to the em-dash, or rename the function and confirm a lone hyphen is the intended cover-page marker for missing risk_level/analysis_timestamp.

title: SSR renders draft_prep_note unconditionally; JS-swap sync comment and form_draft.js untouched
evidence:
+        html.li([], [html.text(form_copy.draft_prep_note)]),
+// Applicant-facing copy for draft save/resume. The checklist item 6 line and
+// the continue-link button strings ALSO live in `priv/static/form_draft.js`
-/// F3-SEAM (shipped): the SSR note keeps the honest one-visit line for
-/// no-JS clients; `form_draft.js` swaps in the save-and-continue promise
-/// (form_copy.draft_prep_note) when the draft saver is actually active —
detail: SSR now renders draft_prep_note unconditionally, retiring the documented JS swap. But form_draft.js is untouched and the header still claims the line ALSO lives there — so the swap is either dead (its target element is gone) or the comment is stale.
recommended_fix: Inspect form_draft.js: drop the swap that targeted the now-deleted [data-testid=prep-note] node, and fix the stale KEEP-IN-SYNC comment.
